posts.title: New Releases with KQRS’s Gorman in the Morning
posts.description: Dear readers, This morning, I returned to Gorman in the Morning on KQRS (92.5 FM), Minnesota’s rock radio station, to talk movies with hosts Steve Gorman, Ryder, and guest/author Steven Hyden. We talked about several new and upcoming releases: Wild Horse Nine, Paper Tiger, The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, Elsinore, Behemouth!, I Play Rocky, and Trauma or, Monsters All. posts.title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
posts.description: Netflix will release The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth in theaters on November 25. It will arrive on the streamer on December 23. Continuing the infectious, effortlessly enjoyable hangout vibe of Quentin Tarantino’s Once Upon a Time in Hollywood (2019), The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth has one glaring flaw.
